title: IndiGo extends Saudi flight suspensions (advisory, 10 Nov 2026): Jeddah and Madinah until 21 Nov, Riyadh and Dammam until 30 Nov, both inclusive; IndiGo cites safety and security considerations and alerts affected customers on their booking contact details; paused since mid-October, restart pushed back more than once; Saudi-led coalition says it downed Houthi missiles over Riyadh; Saudi officials say debris from an attempted attack damaged an Aramco building in Riyadh on 8 Nov
